headline: 10 Michigan deals, $34.8M raised — led by Sturgis Bancorp Inc

top_deals.summary: Sturgis Bancorp Inc, a Sturgis-based commercial banking company, filed a $25.5M debt offering under Rule 506(b); $25.5M sold to 24 investors.
DTC Residences Mezz Lender LLC, a Traverse City-based company, filed a $10M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $0 sold.
CleanBotix, Inc., a Grand Rapids-based technology company, filed a $10M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $6M sold to 1 investor.
Lumiom Inc., a West Bloomfield Township-based technology company, filed a $3M SAFE offering under Rule 506(b); $100K sold to 1 investor.
NSC Urbandale, LLC, a Farmington Hills-based investment fund, disclosed a $2.2M raise; $2.2M sold to 21 investors.

new_funds.summary: NSC Urbandale, LLC, a Farmington Hills-based investment fund, disclosed a $2.2M raise; $2.2M sold to 21 investors.

notable_ma.summary: Hagerty Holding Corp. reported a 56.5% stake in Hagerty, Inc. (HGTY) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 3).

material_agreements.summary: Hagerty, Inc. (HGTY) entered into a material definitive agreement (debt offering).
Cooper-Standard Holdings Inc. (CPS) entered into a material definitive agreement (credit facility).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $34.8M sold across 7 Form D filings this week, down 49% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Sturgis Bancorp Inc (Sturgis, Commercial Banking) targeting $25.5M. Good question to ask: are founders in financial services favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $2.2M raised so far — led by NSC Urbandale, LLC (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?

Hagerty Holding Corp. reported a 56.5% stake in Hagerty, Inc. (HGTY) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 3). Schedule 13D filers can push for strategic change, so it's worth asking whether shareholders see a sale or restructuring on the table.
